lines.zh: 我在草叶上爬，红壳晃着。
lines.en: I crawl along the grass blade, red shell swaying.

lines.zh: 六条小脚抓住叶片边缘。
lines.en: Six little legs grip the leaf edge.
I go around a dewdrop.
My red shell stands out on the green leaf.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶子走到另一片。
lines.en: I cross from one leaf to the next.
This blade of grass is taller than me.
I lift my shell to feel the way.
I work my way down the stem.
The blade bends and I slide a way.
I reach the leaf tip and turn back.

lines.zh: 我的红壳上有黑点，很显眼。
lines.en: My red shell with black spots stands out.
I go slowly and I do not fear falling.
I squeeze between two leaves.

lines.zh: 我贴着叶面露出来一点。
lines.en: I show a little above the leaf face.

lines.zh: 我一路往上，找更嫩的地方。
lines.en: I climb for the tenderer growth.
I stop and clean my antennae.
I lie in the leaf center, sunning my shell.

lines.zh: 有蚜虫在旁边，我很高兴。
lines.en: Aphids nearby. I am pleased.
My red shell shines in the sun.
I open my wing cases and close them.

lines.zh: 叶子上有风，我抓着不放。
lines.en: The leaf moves in the wind. I hold on.
I draw my legs in slowly.

lines.zh: 有一只蚂蚁经过，绕开了我。
lines.en: An ant passed and went around me.

lines.zh: 我在数这一株上有几只蚜虫。
lines.en: I am counting the aphids on this plant.
My antennae tap the leaf face.

lines.zh: 这棵植物上，同伴还有几只。
lines.en: There are a few of my kind on this plant.

lines.zh: 我踩着叶脉，像走一条路。
lines.en: I walk the veins like a road.

lines.zh: 太阳过去了，我往另一边挪。
lines.en: The sun moved on. I shift the other way.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我一片叶子。
lines.en: Your shadow covers a whole leaf of mine.
Do not pinch with your fingers.
I have only seven spots; don't miscount.

lines.zh: 你要看我壳上的点数吗。
lines.en: Do you want to count the spots on my shell?

lines.zh: 你的影子压得我抬不起头。
lines.en: Your shadow pins me down.

lines.zh: 我在叶子上，不在你手上。
lines.en: I am on the leaf, not your hand.

lines.zh: 这一片草上有很多我这样的。
lines.en: There are plenty like me on this grass.

lines.zh: 你蹲着看，我就能看清你。
lines.en: Crouched like that, you are easy to see.
I do not bite, but do not grab me.

lines.zh: 我背后有翅，飞起来很快。
lines.en: I have wings behind this shell. I can fly fast.
My wing case has been pried open.
I flipped over and my legs are kicking.

lines.zh: 我背上七颗点，一只不少。
lines.en: Seven spots on my back, all intact.

lines.zh: 我的红壳上有七个黑点。
lines.en: There are seven black spots on my red shell.

lines.zh: 我缩起腿，装成一颗小石头。
lines.en: I tuck my legs and play dead.

lines.zh: 我掉到下一片叶子上了。
lines.en: I landed on the leaf below.
This small pain passes quickly.
I grip the leaf and steady.
I can still crawl, just slowly.

lines.zh: 我又张开鞘翅，检查了一下。
lines.en: I open my wing cases and check them.
Is that the smell of aphids?
That much I can eat.
I work my way down the stem.

lines.zh: 这不是蚜虫，我闻出来了。
lines.en: That is not an aphid. I can tell.

lines.zh: 我把触角伸出去试了试。
lines.en: I extend my antennae and test it.

lines.zh: 太硬了，我的口器吃不进。
lines.en: Too hard for these mouthparts.

lines.zh: 我只吃小小的、软的东西。
lines.en: I eat only small soft things.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在叶子上吧。
lines.en: Leave it on the leaf.
This small mouthful will last me half a day.
Wrong taste. I turn away.

lines.zh: 你碰了草叶，我就滑了一下。
lines.en: You touched the blade and I slipped.
I held on. I did not fall.
Do not blow. I would be swept away.
That much sway does not trouble me.
I slip to the underside of the leaf.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压断了这株草。
lines.en: Your boot broke this plant.

lines.zh: 我顺着茎往下退了一段。
lines.en: I retreat down the stem a way.
I collided with another of my kind.
It flipped over and I went around.

lines.zh: 我爬到安全的地方去了。
lines.en: I have climbed somewhere safer.
There are several on this plant.

lines.zh: 它们壳上的点数不一样。
lines.en: Their spot counts differ.

lines.zh: 有一只在我上面的叶子上。
lines.en: One is on the leaf above me.
We seldom meet.
It is a little larger and rounder.

lines.zh: 有一次我们在同一片叶上。
lines.en: Once we shared a leaf.

lines.zh: 我们头对头站了一会儿。
lines.en: We stood head to head a while.

lines.zh: 然后各自爬到另一边去。
lines.en: Then each of us went the other way.

lines.zh: 这株植物够我们吃很久。
lines.en: This plant feeds us all for a long while.

lines.zh: 冬天来之前，我们都会藏起来。
lines.en: Before winter we will all hide away.
This crumb is too much for me.
I push at it with a front leg.
An egg. Not mine.
I dip an antenna into the dewdrop.

lines.zh: 这片叶子上有糖一样的东西。
lines.en: Something sweet is on this leaf.
I take a little of it.
A fleck of something stuck to my shell.
I push it a short way.
Too heavy. I give up.
There is nothing I need to carry.
Aphids ahead.
The sweetness of aphids drifts over.
That soft thing is moving.
Something is crowding the new bud.
The vein runs straight there.
They are all clustered on the shoot.
That is very close.
My legs quicken.

lines.zh: 有只蚂蚁也在往那边去。
lines.en: An ant is heading there too.
I must hurry.
I get there first.
I pause and watch.
I point my mouthparts at the bud.
The aphids are packed together.
One has strayed.
I fix on that one.
It moves slowly.

lines.zh: 我翅上的黑点，是数出来的。
lines.en: The black spots on my wings can be counted.
A few inches more.
The ant is on the far side.
I arrived first.
I extend my mouthparts slowly.
It is still chewing the shoot.
This one will be clean.
I take the aphid in my jaws.
It curled once and was gone.

lines.zh: 这么小一只，我一口就咽了。
lines.en: So small, I swallow it in one go.
The next one starts to flee.
I chase it two inches.

lines.zh: 蚂蚁过来抢，我顶了它一下。
lines.en: An ant came for it and I shoved it.
My shell is harder than its own.
It withdrew and I went on eating.
That was a full meal.
I lift a foreleg and wipe my mouth.
I climb from the underside to the face.

lines.zh: 这株植物上有好几只我这样的。
lines.en: There are several like me on this plant.

lines.zh: 我的红壳在绿里很显眼。
lines.en: My red shell stands out in the green.
First I find a bit of shade.
The dew has not dried. I go around.
I crack my wing cases and test the air.

lines.zh: 这片草地够我待一整天。
lines.en: This grass will keep me all day.
I flip from the leaf's underside onto its face.
One of my kind is right beside me.

lines.zh: 我从茎上下来，换了一株。
lines.en: I come down the stem and change plants.

lines.zh: 热气一烤，我立刻飞起来。
lines.en: The heat made me take flight at once.
I dropped off the leaf into the soil.

lines.zh: 露水把我困住了，我划不动。
lines.en: Dew trapped me and I cannot paddle.

lines.zh: 爆响把我从叶子上震落。
lines.en: The blast shook me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 一支箭弹开了我的鞘翅。
lines.en: An arrow flicks my wing case open.
Strange light numbed my legs.
There are no aphids left on this plant.
The thunder froze me where I stood.
The leaf is gone and I am falling.
